text: Wine is arrogant, strong drink is riotous;none who are intoxicated by them are wise. [1] [AA]
The terror of a king is like the roar of a lion; [AB]those who incur his anger forfeit their lives.
A person gains honor by avoiding strife,while every fool starts a quarrel. [2]
In seedtime sluggards do not plow;when they look for the harvest, it is not there.
The intention of the human heart is deep water,but the intelligent draw it forth. [3] [AC]
Many say, "My loyal friend,"but who can find someone worthy of trust?
The just walk in integrity;happy are their children after them!
A king seated on the throne of judgmentdispels all evil with his glance. [4]
Who can say, "I have made my heart clean, [AD]I am cleansed of my sin"? [5]
Varying weights, varying measures,are both an abomination to the Lord. [AE]
In their actions even children can playactthough their deeds be blameless and right. [6]
The ear that hears, the eye that sees—the Lord has made them both. [7]
Do not love sleep lest you be reduced to poverty;keep your eyes open, have your fill of food.
"Bad, bad!" says the buyer,then goes away only to boast. [8]
One can put on gold and abundant jewels,but wise lips are the most precious ornament. [9]
Take the garment of the one who became surety for a stranger; [AF]if for foreigners, exact the pledge! [10]
Bread earned by deceit is sweet,but afterward the mouth is filled with gravel.
Plans made with advice succeed;with wise direction wage your war.
A slanderer reveals secrets;so have nothing to do with a babbler!
Those who curse father or mother—their lamp will go out [11] in the dead of night. [AG]
Possessions greedily guarded at the outsetwill not be blessed in the end. [12]
Do not say, "I will repay evil!"Wait for the Lord, who will help you. [13] [AH]
Varying weights are an abomination to the Lord,and false scales are not good. [AI]
Our steps are from the Lord; [AJ]how, then, can mortals understand their way? [14]
It is a trap to pledge rashly a sacred gift,and after a vow, then to reflect. [15]
A wise king winnows the wicked,and threshes them under the cartwheel. [16]
A lamp from the Lord is human life-breath;it searches through the inmost being. [17]
His steadfast loyalty safeguards the king,and he upholds his throne by justice. [AK]
The glory of the young is their strength,and the dignity of the old is gray hair. [AL]
Evil is cleansed away by bloody lashes,and a scourging to the inmost being.
